ev.q: In 2012, 20% of residential care communities used EHRs.
Greater proportions of communities with larger numbers of beds used EHRs compared with communities with fewer beds.
Communities with >100 beds (36%) were more than three times as likely as communities with 4–10 beds (11%) to use EHRs.
